task_set: Week 6 Practical — Task Set C (HR policy)
note: Every case carries exactly one Week-5 taxonomy mode so the runner can print pass rate BY MODE. Cases with kind=regression are replayed verbatim from real failed /ask traces in logs/ask_traces.jsonl: the recorded answer is scored as-is and never regenerated, so a fixed failure cannot come back unnoticed. Cases with kind=live are answered by the current app at run time.

cases.question: What is the planned leave notice period?
cases.frozen_answer: According to [1] SOURCE=leave-policy.txt, employees must submit planned leave requests at least 5 working days in advance.
cases.why: Real failure. The internal prompt label SOURCE= leaked into the user-visible answer.

cases.question: Can emergency leave be requested on the same day?
cases.frozen_answer: According to the provided context, yes, emergency leave can be requested on the same day by informing the reporting manager.
cases.why: Real failure. The API returned citation metadata but the answer text carried no [n] marker, so nothing in the sentence was traceable.

cases.question: Can emergency leave be requested on the same day?
cases.frozen_answer: Yes, emergency leave can be requested on the same day. According to the leave policy, "Emergency leave can be requested on the same day by informing the reporting manager."
cases.why: Real failure. Quotes the source in prose but still has no numbered citation, so a reader cannot tell which clause.
